name: Benmore Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A mountaintop valley in southwestern Lake County, within the North Coast, much cooler than surrounding areas. Chardonnay was the grape of choice when the AVA was formed, but the valley is not currently planted with vineyards. It is named for a 19th century cattle rustler.
